title: Muvaki weChido Chenhema
intro: Munhu ane simba guru akamboshanda semumwe wevatongi vane mukurumbira munhoroondo muIjipita yekare. Munhu uyu akapihwa murairo wakashinga - wekuvaka chivakwa chakagadzirirwa kushora matenga. Nyaya yavo iri muKorani sechidzidzo chinoshamisa pamusoro pekuti kuteerera kuzvikudza pasina kufunga kunotungamira sei mukuparadzwa.
clues: Ndakashanda mumatare emutongi ane simba uyo aiti ndiye mwari wenyika.
Ndaiva nechinzvimbo chepamusoro chehufundisi, ndichipa mazano kumunhu ainyanya kuzvitutumadza kupfuura vamwe vese munguva yangu.
Mutongi wangu akanga anyura mukupikisa Mwari waMosesi, wavakaramba kubvuma.
Ndakarayirwa kuvaka shongwe yezvidhinha zvakapiswa nemoto kuitira kuti mutongi wangu akwire kudenga.
Nhare yacho haina kumbosvika kudenga, uye kushumira kwangu kuzvikudza kwakaita kuti ndinyare nekusingaperi.
Ndakaparara pamwe chete newandakatevera, uye zita rangu rakava yambiro inogara iripo kune avo vanobvumira vadzvinyiriri.
